name: nsds-design-system
description: NS Design System — the design system behind Namaste Salesforce: tokens, base, layout, components, sections and learning templates compiled to one stylesheet.

scripts.build: sass src/scss/screen.scss dist/css/screen.css --style=expanded --no-source-map && sass src/scss/screen.scss dist/css/screen.min.css --style=compressed --no-source-map && mkdir -p dist/fonts dist/js && cp src/fonts/*.woff2 dist/fonts/ && cp src/js/nsds.js dist/js/nsds.js
scripts.stage: rm -rf _site && mkdir -p _site && cp *.html llms.txt _site/ && cp -R templates dist assets _site/ && cp DESIGN.md design-guidelines.md design-components.md _site/ && echo salesforce.imswarnil.com > _site/CNAME && touch _site/.nojekyll
